name: LOX 2% Jelly 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LOX 2% JELLY

LOX 2% Jelly is a topical anesthetic gel containing Lidocaine (Lignocaine) 2% as its active ingredient. It is commonly used by healthcare professionals to numb skin and mucous membranes, helping to reduce discomfort during minor surgical, dental and diagnostic procedures. LOX 2% Jelly provides fast-acting numbness at the site of application. Its smooth gel formula ensures easy and precise application, making it a preferred choice for both healthcare professionals and patients needing localized pain relief.

The primary use of LOX 2% Jelly is to numb the skin or mucous membranes, helping to ease pain and discomfort associated with procedures such as suturing, catheter insertion, endoscopy, dental work and minor surgeries. It is also indicated for managing pain from skin irritation, burns, scratches, insect bites, abrasions and sunburn. Additionally, it may be used for conditions like hemorrhoids, anal fissures, and to support pain management in urethritis or during endotracheal intubation. LOX 2% Jelly contains Lignocaine (Lidocaine) 2%, which works by blocking nerve signals to prevent the transmission of pain sensations, providing targeted relief within 3–5 minutes of application.

Precautions include washing hands before and after use, avoiding application to broken or infected skin, and not allowing the jelly to come into contact with eyes, nose, or mouth. Important warnings include not using more than recommended, seeking medical advice if side effects persist, and consulting a doctor before use if you have underlying health conditions or are taking other medications. LOX 2% Jelly is generally not recommended for children unless specifically directed by a healthcare provider, as safety and effectiveness have not been established in this age group

For pregnant or breastfeeding women, LOX 2% Jelly should only be used if clearly needed and under medical supervision. Common side effects may include mild burning, itching, redness, or irritation at the application site, which usually resolve on their own. However, persistent or severe reactions should be reported to a healthcare professional immediately.

mechanismOfAction:
How LOX 2% JELLY Works
How LOX 2% Jelly Numbs the Skin and Mucous Membranes

LOX 2% Jelly works temporarily numbing the area where it is applied. When spread over the skin or mucous membranes, it penetrates the surface and interacts with local nerve endings. The lidocaine molecules block the nerve signals responsible for transmitting pain, resulting in a localized loss of sensation and reduced discomfort

Understanding Nerve Signal Blockade by LOX 2% Jelly

The key to LOX 2% Jelly’s action lies in its ability to block nerve signals at the site of application. Lidocaine, the active component, binds to sodium channels in the nerve cell membranes. This binding prevents sodium ions from entering the nerve cells, which is essential for the initiation and propagation of nerve impulses. As a result, pain signals are unable to travel to the brain, and the applied area feels numb

Preventing Pain Transmission with LOX 2% Jelly

By stabilizing the neuronal membrane and inhibiting the ionic fluxes necessary for nerve impulse generation, LOX 2% Jelly prevents pain signals from being transmitted. This means that sensations of pain, itching, or burning are not relayed to the brain, providing effective and targeted relief for the use

Fast-Acting Effect of LOX 2% Jelly

LOX 2% Jelly is known for its rapid onset of action. Typically, the numbing effect begins within 3 to 5 minutes after application, making it a practical choice for quick pain relief during medical procedures or for managing minor skin discomfort. Its fast-acting nature is due to lidocaine’s ability to quickly reach and block nerve endings at the site of application.

Use only as directed by your doctor or healthcare provider.

Consult your doctor if you do not experience relief after 2–4 weeks of use.

Common application sites include the anus, vagina, skin around wounds, mouth, throat, or nose (for medical procedures like catheterization or endoscopy).
Do not apply to broken, infected, or irritated skin unless instructed by a healthcare professional.
Avoid application to the face, eyes, eyelids, mouth, or nose unless specifically directed.
Use LOX 2% Jelly externally only.

warnings.details: LOX 2% Jelly is generally considered safe during pregnancy. Animal studies show minimal risks to fetal development, but human data is limited. Use only under medical supervision

Lidocaine in LOX 2% Jelly is likely safe while breastfeeding. Only trace amounts may pass into breast milk, posing negligible risk to the infant. Wash hands after application and avoid contact with breasts/nipples
No significant impairment is expected when used as directed. However, avoid driving if experiencing side effects like dizziness, drowsiness, or blurred vision
Use with caution in liver disease (e.g., cirrhosis). Impaired metabolism may increase systemic absorption and toxicity risk. Monitor for symptoms like dizziness or confusion
Do not use LOX 2% Jelly if you are allergic to Lignocaine or any other ingredients of this medicine.
LOX 2% Jelly should be used with caution in patients with bradycardia or impaired cardiovascular function and severe shock or heart rhythm disorders.
LOX 2% Jelly is not recommended for children. Safety and efficacy are unestablished in this age group
LOX 2% Jelly should be used with caution in patients aged above 65 years. Higher susceptibility to side effects like dizziness or confusion requires dosage adjustments

name: Toplap Gel 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About TOPLAP GEL

Toplap Gel is a local anaesthetic used as a local analgesia for normal intact skin and for superficial minor surgery and pre-management for infiltration anaesthesia in genital mucous membranes. It contains Lidocaine and Prilocaine as an active ingredient which is used as a local analgesia.

Lidocaine and Prilocaine is a local anaesthetic, which acts by blocking pain signals from nerves to the brain, thereby decreasing the sensation of pain.  

Always apply Toplap Gel as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Squeeze the necessary amount of gel into a mound and use a spatula to spread it out into a thick, even layer that is 2-3 mm height. Never rub the gel into the affected area. Do not use in children under one month of age. Do not apply near eyes or open wounds.

name: XYLOCAINE 2% Jelly 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About XYLOCAINE 2% JELLY

XYLOCAINE 2% Jelly is a topical anesthetic used for pain relief during medical procedures. It is a powerful local anesthetic gel that provides fast and effective pain relief by numbing the affected area during minor surgical and medical procedures. This pain relief Gel contains lidocaine, a trusted ingredient used worldwide for numbing pain in small, localized areas.

Xylocaine Jelly will be applied to areas which require numbness by your doctor or a nurse. A thin layer of the medicine will be applied on the skin regions which require numbness, and your doctor will wait until the numbness happens before beginning the surgery or medical procedures.

Before using Xylocaine 2% Jelly inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any infections or injuries at the site of application, or pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution. While topical medicines typically do not interact with other medications, it is important to inform your doctor about any other medicines you are taking as a precaution.

The most common side effects of this medicine include skin redness, skin irritation, skin rash, skin burning, and skin itching at the site of application or other adverse effects. These effects are generally mild and temporary. If any side effects persist or cause concern, consult your doctor.
uses: Local anesthesia prior to surgical, invasive and diagnostic procedures
Quick Onset of Action: Xylocaine 2% Jelly works rapidly, typically within minutes of administration, making it ideal for procedures requiring immediate pain relief.

Targeted Relief: Unlike general anesthetics, Xylocaine 2% Jelly numbs only the specific area where it is applied, allowing patients to remain conscious and aware while experiencing no pain in the treated region.

Versatile Use: Xylocaine 2% Jelly is often used for dental procedures, minor surgeries, and even during labor for epidurals or regional blocks. It is also used to manage pain from conditions like shingles or for performing diagnostic tests.
Reduced Systemic Side Effects: Since Xylocaine 2% Jelly is applied locally, the potential for systemic side effects is minimized compared to oral pain medications or general anesthesia.
Long-Lasting Relief: Xylocaine 2% Jelly effects can last from 30 minutes to several hours, depending on the dosage and method of administration, providing extended relief during medical procedures.

Have a history of methemoglobinemia

6. Trusted by Healthcare Professionals

Doctors, dentists, and medical professionals trust Xylocaine 2% Jelly for its effectiveness and reliability. Its proven track record makes it the first choice in many medical environments.

7. Long-Lasting Effect

The anesthetic effect of Xylocaine 2% Jelly lasts for a sufficient amount of time to complete most medical procedures, reducing the need for reapplication.

8. Minimal Side Effects

Xylocaine 2% Jelly is well-known for having fewer side effects compared to other anesthetics. When used properly, it offers a safe and effective way to manage pain.

Conclusion

When it comes to choosing an anesthetic for pain relief during medical procedures, Xylocaine 2% Jelly stands out due to its fast action, effectiveness, and safety profile. Trusted by medical professionals, this versatile and easy-to-use product provides an optimal experience for both patients and healthcare providers. introduction:
Introduction About DOLOCAINE CREAM

DOLOCAINE CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine and Prilocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anesthetic agents. It is used to cause temporary numbness (loss of pain sensation) of the normal intact skin and genital mucosal membranes when applied topically.

It is primarily used to abolish pain signals prior to surgical and diagnostic procedures on the skin and genital areas (such as during insertion of needles or catheters, during certain painful vaccinations (such as MMR, flu, hepatitis, DPT), during minor surgeries of genital areas (such as removal of foreskin around the penis) and during laser management or other cosmetic procedures involving the skin surface).

DOLOCAINE CREAM can also be used to temporarily numb skin before injecting an anesthetic solution and can be used to abolish pain signals while removing dead and damaged skin/cells among patients with leg ulcers. It also provides relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (red, itchy skin) in adults.

DOLOCAINE CREAM is suitable for use both in adults and in children (including infants and newborns). It should be used only under careful medical supervision. It will be applied to you only by a doctor or nurse at skin surfaces where loss of sensation is required.

Before DOLOCAINE CREAM is applied onto your skin, inform your doctor if you have any genetic disorders (like G6PD deficiency) or blood problems (such as methemoglobinemia). You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before this medicine is given to you as a precaution.

DOLOCAINE CREAM is not suitable for use in patients with problems in ear drum. The most common side effects of using DOLOCAINE CREAM are paleness, redness, swelling, mild burning sensation, itching or warmth at the managed area. Consult your doctor if it bothers you.
uses: Cause temporary numbness of normal intact skin or genital mucous membrane
Provide temporary relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (such as skin rash, itching)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLOCAINE CREAM

Used as topical anesthesia prior to surgical and diagnostic procedures to:

Cause temporary numbness of normal intact skin or genital mucous membrane
Provide temporary relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (such as skin rash, itching)
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOCAINE CREAM Works

DOLOCAINE CREAM is a local anesthetic medication. When applied topically, it blocks the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that causes pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral part of the body (i.e., face, hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, genitals or where the medicine has been applied) to the brain which ultimately leads to loss of sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLOCAINE CREAM

DOLOCAINE CREAM should be used only under careful medical supervision. It is strictly for external use only. It will be applied to you only by a doctor or nurse at skin surfaces where loss of sensation is required.

Avoid accidental contact of this medicine with your eyes, nose, ears, mouth or anus and with damaged skin surfaces including minor cuts on the skin.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition and sites where numbness is required in the body.

name: LIDOVAC Jelly 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LIDOVAC JELLY

LIDOVAC JELLY contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It causes numbness of body parts at sites where it has been applied. It is used for temporary relief of pain and discomfort associated with skin abrasions, sun burns, insect bites, sore nipples, haemorrhoids (piles), anal fissures, bed sores, shingles, or cold sores (painful skin rash or blisters around the mouth due to viral infections).

It can also be used to relieve pain following circumcision in children (a surgery that removes the foreskin from the human penis) and to soothe itching around the rectum, anus (pruritus ani), or female genitalia (vulva).

It also relieves pain caused by oral sores and can numb the mouth and throat prior to any dental procedures (such as scaling or denture fixing).

It acts as an anaesthetic lubricant for catheterization, intubation, and other diagnostic procedures (such as proctoscopy, rectoscopy, cystoscopy, gastroscopy, bronchoscopy, esophagoscopy, etc.).

If you are managed with LIDOVAC JELLY in your oral cavity, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 60 minutes or until sensation comes back in your mouth. This is because you may experience trouble swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period.

Before using LIDOVAC JELLY, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any infections or injuries at the site of application as a precaution.

LIDOVAC JELLY can be used for pregnant and breastfeeding women if considered necessary. It is generally safe and well tolerated without any major side effects. However, if you experience any skin rash or irritation on the application site or feel drowsy, consult your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How LIDOVAC JELLY Works

LIDOVAC JELLY is a local anaesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness in body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that cause pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral part of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, genitals, or where the medicine has been applied) to the brain, which ultimately leads to loss of sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use LIDOVAC JELLY

LIDOVAC JELLY should be used under proper medical supervision. It is administered by the physician in the region where anesthesia is required. However, it can also be self-administered by the patient if instructed by the doctor.

Take a small quantity of LIDOVAC JELLY and apply it to the required areas. Avoid contact with LIDOVAC JELLY with your eyes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition, and sites where numbness is required in the body.

name: Prilox Cream 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About PRILOX CREAM

PRILOX CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine and Prilocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anesthetic agents. It is used to cause temporary numbness (loss of pain sensation) of the normal intact skin and genital mucosal membranes when applied topically.

It is primarily used to abolish pain signals prior to surgical and diagnostic procedures on the skin and genital areas (such as during insertion of needles or catheters, during certain painful vaccinations (such as MMR, flu, hepatitis, DPT), during minor surgeries of genital areas (such as removal of foreskin around the penis) and during laser management or other cosmetic procedures involving the skin surface).

PRILOX CREAM can also be used to temporarily numb skin before injecting an anesthetic solution and can be used to abolish pain signals while removing dead and damaged skin/cells among patients with leg ulcers. It also provides relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (red, itchy skin) in adults.

PRILOX CREAM is suitable for use both in adults and in children (including infants and newborns). It should be used only under careful medical supervision. It will be applied to you only by a doctor or nurse at skin surfaces where loss of sensation is required.

Before PRILOX CREAM is applied onto your skin, inform your doctor if you have any genetic disorders (like G6PD deficiency) or blood problems (such as methemoglobinemia). You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before this medicine is given to you as a precaution.

PRILOX CREAM is not suitable for use in patients with problems in ear drum. The most common side effects of using PRILOX CREAM are paleness, redness, swelling, mild burning sensation, itching or warmth at the managed area. Consult your doctor if it bothers you.

name: LOX 10% Spray 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About LOX 10% SPRAY

LOX 10% SPRAY contains Lignocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anaesthetics. It is used to cause numbness (loss of sensation) of body parts at sites where it has been administered in the body. It relieves pain and discomfort in the nose and throat following minor surgical procedures (such as the removal of tonsils or adenoid glands).

It also anesthetizes the nose, throat, respiratory tract (lungs), or digestive tract (stomach) prior to the insertion of catheters or certain diagnostic instruments that are used for viewing parts of the body (such as bronchoscopy or esophagoscopy).

It can be used to numb the oral cavity, manage gag reflux (vomiting sensation) that occurs during dental procedures, and manage painful oral conditions (such as oral injury, infection, or inflammation) by alleviating pain sensation. It may also help in managing pain caused by episiotomy (tearing the skin between the vagina and anus during childbirth).

Following the administration of LOX 10% SPRAY, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 1-2 hours or until sensation comes back. This is because you may experience trouble swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period. Do not drink water or other fluids after applying LOX 10% SPRAY, as it may reduce its anaesthetic effects.

Before using LOX 10% SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure, a severe injury or bleeding in the nose, mouth, or throat, or epilepsy before using LOX 10% SPRAY.

LOX 10% SPRAY should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. It is generally safe and well tolerated without any major side effects. However, if you experience any irritation on the application site or feel drowsy, consult your doctor for advice.

How LOX 10% SPRAY Works

LOX 10% SPRAY is a local anaesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness in body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that cause pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral part of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, or where the medicine has been applied) to the brain, which ultimately leads to loss of sensation.
usageDetails:

LOX 10% SPRAY should be used under proper medical supervision. It is usually administered by the physician prior to the surgical or diagnostic procedures. However, it may also be self-administered by the patient if instructed by the doctor for temporary pain relief.

Shake the container before use. Prior to use, prime the medicine to release the correct dose of medicine. Fix the extension tube if it is given in the package. Hold the container with the extension tube or spray nozzle pointing towards the areas of application. Press the button to release the spray. Leave a time gap of 2 seconds between each spray.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, number of sprays, and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and health condition. Avoid contact with LOX 10% SPRAY with your eyes.

name: Toplap Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About TOPLAP GEL

Toplap Gel is a local anaesthetic, which is used on normal intact skin for local analgesia (pain relief). It is also used to numb the skin or surfaces of the penis or vagina for minor surgery or medical procedures. It contains Lidocaine and Prilocaine as an active ingredient.

Lidocaine and Prilocaine is a local anaesthetic, which acts by blocking pain signals from the nerves to the brain, thereby decreasing the sensation of pain.  

Always apply Toplap Gel as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. You may need to apply gel as directed by your doctor at home up to 4 hours before your surgery or procedure. Do not apply near eyes or open wounds. Do not use in children under 1 month of age.
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of TOPLAP GEL

Toplap Gel may cause mild burning, itching, rash, changes in skin colour at the application site. Consult your doctor if you notice any such side effects while applying Toplap Gel.

introduction:
Introduction About XYLOCAINE 2% INJECTION

XYLOCAINE 2% INJECTION contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause numbness (loss of sensation) of body parts in the regions where it has been administered (local anesthesia). It is generally used prior to spinal anesthesia or before surgical procedures to cause a temporary loss of sensation. It also helps to control the heartbeat in patients with arrythmia (an irregular heartbeat).

XYLOCAINE 2% INJECTION will be given to you only by a trained anaesthesiologist around the areas (such as hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, and spine) locally where loss of sensation (numbness) is required.

Before receiving XYLOCAINE 2% INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any breathing disorders, blood problems, epilepsy, glaucoma, stroke, dehydration, low blood potassium levels, or muscle weakness.

XYLOCAINE 2% INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving XYLOCAINE 2% INJECTION are nausea, slow heart rate, dizziness, lower back pain, difficulty walking, and an inability to control urine or bowel movements. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

XYLOCAINE 2% INJECTION is an anaesthetic agent. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral parts of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, and pelvis) to the brain, which leads to a loss of sensation. It also normalizes heart rate by blocking the generation of abnormal electrical signals in the heart.

Your doctor or anaesthesiologist will decide the correct dose and site of administration for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition, and the type of nerve block that is required to provide anesthesia or pain relief.

It can be administered locally to the region where loss of sensation (numbness) is required or can be administered in a vein, around the spinal cord, or a nerve to cause numbness during surgeries (caesarean section or other major surgeries) to stop pain sensation.

introduction:
Introduction About XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION

XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION contains Lignocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anaesthetics. It is used to cause numbness in the oral cavity. It provides pain relief and reduces discomfort in the oral cavity when the mucosal membranes of the mouth or the throat have been inflamed, irritated, or infected.

It also anesthetizes the oral cavity, respiratory tract, and digestive tract prior to the insertion of catheters or certain instruments used during diagnostic procedures (such as bronchoscopy or esophagoscopy). It also helps in managing gag reflux (vomiting sensation) that occurs during dental procedures (such as X-rays of the oral cavity or dental impressions).

XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION may also help in reducing pain and discomfort that is associated with problems of the upper gastrointestinal tract, such as esophagitis (inflammation of the food pipe).

Following the administration of XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 60 minutes or until sensation comes back in your mouth. This is because you may experience trouble swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period. Do not drink water or other fluids after applying XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION, as it may reduce its anaesthetic effects.

Before using XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a severe injury or bleeding in the mouth, throat, or epilepsy before using XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION.

XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of using XYLOCAINE VISCOUS SOLUTION are irritation or itching at the site of application, which is usually mild and disappears once the anaesthetic effect begins. However, consult your doctor if it bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT

XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It causes numbness of body parts at sites where it has been applied. It is used for temporary relief of pain and discomfort associated with skin abrasions, sun burns, insect bites, sore nipples, haemorrhoids (piles), anal fissures, bed sores, shingles, or cold sores (painful skin rash or blisters around the mouth due to viral infections).

It can also be used to relieve pain following circumcision in children (a surgery that removes the foreskin from the human penis) and to soothe itching around the rectum, anus (pruritus ani), or female genitalia (vulva).

It also relieves pain caused by oral sores and can numb the mouth and throat prior to any dental procedures (such as scaling or denture fixing).

It acts as an anaesthetic lubricant for catheterization, intubation, and other diagnostic procedures (such as proctoscopy, rectoscopy, cystoscopy, gastroscopy, bronchoscopy, esophagoscopy, etc.).

If you are managed with XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT in your oral cavity, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 60 minutes or until sensation comes back in your mouth. This is because you may experience trouble swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period.

Before using XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any infections or injuries at the site of application as a precaution.

XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT can be used for pregnant and breastfeeding women if considered necessary. It is generally safe and well tolerated without any major side effects. However, if you experience any skin rash or irritation on the application site or feel drowsy, consult your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT Works

XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT is a local anaesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness in body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that cause pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral part of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, genitals, or where the medicine has been applied) to the brain, which ultimately leads to loss of sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT

XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT should be used under proper medical supervision. It is administered by the physician in the region where anesthesia is required. However, it can also be self-administered by the patient if instructed by the doctor.

Take a small quantity of XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT and apply it to the required areas. Avoid contact with XYLOCAINE 5% OINTMENT with your eyes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition, and sites where numbness is required in the body.

name: Dologel Gel 15gm
introduction:
Introduction About DOLOGEL GEL

Dologel Gel is a fast-acting pain relief gel used for relieving pain due to ulcers in the inner lip, tongue, palate, inner side of cheek, gums and pain due to dentures. It contains choline salicylate, lignocaine and benzalkonium chloride as active ingredients to relieve pain caused by mouth ulcers.      

Choline salicylate reduces inflammation and swelling and speeds up the healing process. Lignocaine hydrochloride is a local anaesthetic that has numbing and cooling effects and temporarily relieves the pain. Benzalkonium chloride kills the bacteria and manages secondary infection in the ulcer, hence promoting rapid ulcer healing.     

Always use Dologel Gel as advised by the doctor. It is for dental use only. Apply the gel sufficiently over the affected area with a clean index finger and stuff the cavity with a soaked cotton swab or as directed by the doctor. Do not exceed the recommended usage. Inform your doctor if you are using or have recently used any other medicines including prescription, over-the-counter medications, as well as herbal products.

introduction:
Introduction About LONG DRIVE SPRAY

LONG DRIVE SPRAY contains Lignocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anaesthetics. It is used to cause numbness (loss of sensation) of body parts at sites where it has been administered in the body. It relieves pain and discomfort in the nose and throat following minor surgical procedures (such as the removal of tonsils or adenoid glands).

It also anesthetizes the nose, throat, respiratory tract (lungs), or digestive tract (stomach) prior to the insertion of catheters or certain diagnostic instruments that are used for viewing parts of the body (such as bronchoscopy or esophagoscopy).

It can be used to numb the oral cavity, manage gag reflux (vomiting sensation) that occurs during dental procedures, and manage painful oral conditions (such as oral injury, infection, or inflammation) by alleviating pain sensation. It may also help in managing pain caused by episiotomy (tearing the skin between the vagina and anus during childbirth).

Following the administration of LONG DRIVE SPRAY, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 1-2 hours or until sensation comes back. This is because you may experience trouble swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period. Do not drink water or other fluids after applying LONG DRIVE SPRAY, as it may reduce its anaesthetic effects.

Before using LONG DRIVE SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood pressure, a severe injury or bleeding in the nose, mouth, or throat, or epilepsy before using LONG DRIVE SPRAY.

LONG DRIVE SPRAY should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. It is generally safe and well tolerated without any major side effects. However, if you experience any irritation on the application site or feel drowsy, consult your doctor for advice.

name: PRILOX Cream 50gm
introduction:
Introduction About PRILOX CREAM

PRILOX CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine and Prilocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anesthetic agents. It is used to cause temporary numbness (loss of pain sensation) of the normal intact skin and genital mucosal membranes when applied topically.

It is primarily used to abolish pain signals prior to surgical and diagnostic procedures on the skin and genital areas (such as during insertion of needles or catheters, during certain painful vaccinations (such as MMR, flu, hepatitis, DPT), during minor surgeries of genital areas (such as removal of foreskin around the penis) and during laser management or other cosmetic procedures involving the skin surface).

PRILOX CREAM can also be used to temporarily numb skin before injecting an anesthetic solution and can be used to abolish pain signals while removing dead and damaged skin/cells among patients with leg ulcers. It also provides relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (red, itchy skin) in adults.

PRILOX CREAM is suitable for use both in adults and in children (including infants and newborns). It should be used only under careful medical supervision. It will be applied to you only by a doctor or nurse at skin surfaces where loss of sensation is required.

Before PRILOX CREAM is applied onto your skin, inform your doctor if you have any genetic disorders (like G6PD deficiency) or blood problems (such as methemoglobinemia). You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before this medicine is given to you as a precaution.

PRILOX CREAM is not suitable for use in patients with problems in ear drum. The most common side effects of using PRILOX CREAM are paleness, redness, swelling, mild burning sensation, itching or warmth at the managed area. Consult your doctor if it bothers you.
uses: Cause temporary numbness of normal intact skin or genital mucous membrane
Provide temporary relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (such as skin rash, itching)
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRILOX CREAM

Used as topical anesthesia prior to surgical and diagnostic procedures to:

Cause temporary numbness of normal intact skin or genital mucous membrane
Provide temporary relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (such as skin rash, itching)
mechanismOfAction:
How PRILOX CREAM Works

PRILOX CREAM is a local anesthetic medication. When applied topically, it blocks the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that causes pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral part of the body (i.e., face, hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, genitals or where the medicine has been applied) to the brain which ultimately leads to loss of sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use PRILOX CREAM

PRILOX CREAM should be used only under careful medical supervision. It is strictly for external use only. It will be applied to you only by a doctor or nurse at skin surfaces where loss of sensation is required.

Avoid accidental contact of this medicine with your eyes, nose, ears, mouth or anus and with damaged skin surfaces including minor cuts on the skin.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition and sites where numbness is required in the body.

introduction:
Introduction About LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION

LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION contains Lignocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anaesthetics. It is used to cause numbness in the oral cavity. It provides pain relief and reduces discomfort in the oral cavity when the mucosal membranes of the mouth or the throat have been inflamed, irritated, or infected.

It also anesthetizes the oral cavity, respiratory tract, and digestive tract prior to the insertion of catheters or certain instruments used during diagnostic procedures (such as bronchoscopy or esophagoscopy). It also helps in managing gag reflux (vomiting sensation) that occurs during dental procedures (such as X-rays of the oral cavity or dental impressions).

LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION may also help in reducing pain and discomfort that is associated with problems of the upper gastrointestinal tract, such as esophagitis (inflammation of the food pipe).

Following the administration of LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 60 minutes or until sensation comes back in your mouth. This is because you may experience trouble swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period. Do not drink water or other fluids after applying LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION, as it may reduce its anaesthetic effects.

Before using LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have a severe injury or bleeding in the mouth, throat, or epilepsy before using LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION.

LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of using LOX 4% TOPICAL SOLUTION are irritation or itching at the site of application, which is usually mild and disappears once the anaesthetic effect begins. However, consult your doctor if it bothers you.

name: Dolocaine Cream 5gm
introduction:
Introduction About DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine and Prilocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anesthetic agents. It is used to cause temporary numbness (loss of pain sensation) of the normal intact skin and genital mucosal membranes when applied topically.

It is primarily used to abolish pain signals prior to surgical and diagnostic procedures on the skin and genital areas (such as during insertion of needles or catheters, during certain painful vaccinations (such as MMR, flu, hepatitis, DPT), during minor surgeries of genital areas (such as removal of foreskin around the penis) and during laser management or other cosmetic procedures involving the skin surface).

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM can also be used to temporarily numb skin before injecting an anesthetic solution and can be used to abolish pain signals while removing dead and damaged skin/cells among patients with leg ulcers. It also provides relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (red, itchy skin) in adults.

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is suitable for use both in adults and in children (including infants and newborns). It should be used only under careful medical supervision. It will be applied to you only by a doctor or nurse at skin surfaces where loss of sensation is required.

Before DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is applied onto your skin, inform your doctor if you have any genetic disorders (like G6PD deficiency) or blood problems (such as methemoglobinemia). You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before this medicine is given to you as a precaution.

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is not suitable for use in patients with problems in ear drum. The most common side effects of using DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM are paleness, redness, swelling, mild burning sensation, itching or warmth at the managed area. Consult your doctor if it bothers you.
uses: Cause temporary numbness of normal intact skin or genital mucous membrane
Provide temporary relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (such as skin rash, itching)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM

Used as topical anesthesia prior to surgical and diagnostic procedures to:

Cause temporary numbness of normal intact skin or genital mucous membrane
Provide temporary relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (such as skin rash, itching)
mechanismOfAction:
How DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM Works

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is a local anesthetic medication. When applied topically, it blocks the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that causes pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral part of the body (i.e., face, hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, genitals or where the medicine has been applied) to the brain which ultimately leads to loss of sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM should be used only under careful medical supervision. It is strictly for external use only. It will be applied to you only by a doctor or nurse at skin surfaces where loss of sensation is required.

Avoid accidental contact of this medicine with your eyes, nose, ears, mouth or anus and with damaged skin surfaces including minor cuts on the skin.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition and sites where numbness is required in the body.
sideEffects: Application site reactions (such as paleness, redness, swelling, initial mild burning sensation, itching or warmth at the managed area)
Signs of allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat, or tongue causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing, fainting)
Signs of methemoglobinemia (such as lack of oxygen, breathlessness)

Signs of allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat, or tongue causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing, fainting)
Signs of methemoglobinemia (such as lack of oxygen, breathlessness)

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM should be used with caution among breastfeeding women. Therefore, inform your doctor before application.
DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is unlikely to affect your ability for driving or handling heavy tools or machines.
Talk to your doctor before DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is applied onto your skin, if you are allergic to lignocaine, prilocaine or to any other local anesthetic agents (such as bupivacaine).

Others

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is not recommended for use if you:

Have cuts or bruises on the skin surface
Have open wound (apart from leg ulcers)
Have problems in ear drum (such as impaired ear drum)

Before DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM is applied onto your skin, inform your physician if you:

Have G6PD deficiency (a genetic problem)
Have methemoglobinemia (abnormal amount of blood components)

Use in pediatrics:

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM can be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) if prescribed by the physician. However, it should not be used on the genital areas of children aged below 12 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before application.

Use in geriatrics:

DOLOCAINE 5GM CREAM should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before application.

name: Anas Dee Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About ANAS DEE GEL

ANAS DEE GEL contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It causes numbness of body parts at sites where it has been applied. It is used for temporary relief of pain and discomfort associated with skin abrasions, sun burns, insect bites, sore nipples, haemorrhoids (piles), anal fissures, bed sores, shingles, or cold sores (painful skin rash or blisters around the mouth due to viral infections).

It can also be used to relieve pain following circumcision in children (a surgery that removes the foreskin from the human penis) and to soothe itching around the rectum, anus (pruritus ani), or female genitalia (vulva).

It also relieves pain caused by oral sores and can numb the mouth and throat prior to any dental procedures (such as scaling or denture fixing).

It acts as an anaesthetic lubricant for catheterization, intubation, and other diagnostic procedures (such as proctoscopy, rectoscopy, cystoscopy, gastroscopy, bronchoscopy, esophagoscopy, etc.).

If you are managed with ANAS DEE GEL in your oral cavity, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 60 minutes or until sensation comes back in your mouth. This is because you may experience trouble swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period.

Before using ANAS DEE GEL, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any infections or injuries at the site of application as a precaution.

ANAS DEE GEL can be used for pregnant and breastfeeding women if considered necessary. It is generally safe and well tolerated without any major side effects. However, if you experience any skin rash or irritation on the application site or feel drowsy, consult your doctor for advice.

usesDetails:
Uses Of ANAS DEE GEL

It causes numbness and provides temporary relief from pain, itching, and discomfort associated with:

Skin abrasions, sun burns, insect bites, sore nipples
Shingles, bed sores, and cold sores
Haemorrhoids (piles), anal fissures, pruritus ani (itching of the anus)
Pruritus vulvae (itching of female genitalia)
Circumcision (a surgery that removes the foreskin from the human penis) in children
Oral sores and dental procedures (such as scaling or denture fixing)
Invasive procedures (such as the insertion of catheters or intubation tubes)
Diagnostic procedures (such as proctoscopy, rectoscopy, cystoscopy, gastroscopy, bronchoscopy, esophagoscopy, etc.)
mechanismOfAction:
How ANAS DEE GEL Works

ANAS DEE GEL is a local anaesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness in body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that cause pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral part of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, genitals, or where the medicine has been applied) to the brain, which ultimately leads to loss of sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use ANAS DEE GEL

ANAS DEE GEL should be used under proper medical supervision. It is administered by the physician in the region where anesthesia is required. However, it can also be self-administered by the patient if instructed by the doctor.

Take a small quantity of ANAS DEE GEL and apply it to the required areas. Avoid contact with ANAS DEE GEL with your eyes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition, and sites where numbness is required in the body.

name: Loxicard Injection 50ml
introduction:
Introduction About LOXICARD INJECTION

LOXICARD INJECTION contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause numbness (loss of sensation) of body parts in the regions where it has been administered (local anesthesia). It is generally used prior to spinal anesthesia or before surgical procedures to cause a temporary loss of sensation. It also helps to control the heartbeat in patients with arrythmia (an irregular heartbeat).

LOXICARD INJECTION will be given to you only by a trained anaesthesiologist around the areas (such as hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, and spine) locally where loss of sensation (numbness) is required.

Before receiving LOXICARD INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any breathing disorders, blood problems, epilepsy, glaucoma, stroke, dehydration, low blood potassium levels, or muscle weakness.

LOXICARD INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving LOXICARD INJECTION are nausea, slow heart rate, dizziness, lower back pain, difficulty walking, and an inability to control urine or bowel movements. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

To manage arrythmia (an irregular heartbeat)

Causes numbness of body parts when used prior to spinal anesthesia or surgical procedures

mechanismOfAction:
How LOXICARD INJECTION Works

LOXICARD INJECTION is an anaesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness in body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that cause pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral parts of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, and pelvis) to the brain, which leads to a loss of sensation. It also normalizes heart rate by blocking the generation of abnormal electrical signals in the heart.
usageDetails:
How to use LOXICARD INJECTION

LOXICARD INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anaesthesiologist. Your doctor or anaesthesiologist will decide the correct dose and site of administration for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition, and the type of nerve block that is required to provide anesthesia or pain relief.

It can be administered locally to the region where loss of sensation (numbness) is required or can be administered in a vein, around the spinal cord, or a nerve to cause numbness during surgeries (caesarean section or other major surgeries) to stop pain sensation.

warnings.details: LOXICARD INJECTION should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant before receiving LOXICARD INJECTION.

LOXICARD INJECTION should be used for breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving LOXICARD INJECTION if you are breastfeeding.

LOXICARD INJECTION may make you feel dizzy or drowsy for some time after administration. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your abilities are affected by LOXICARD INJECTION.
Avoid the consumption of alcohol before receiving LOXICARD INJECTION.
LOXICARD INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
LOXICARD INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Inform your doctor before receiving LOXICARD INJECTION if you are allergic to lignocaine or to any other local anaesthetics (such as bupivacaine).
LOXICARD INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with breathing disorders (such as asthma or COPD). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

LOXICARD INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases (such as heart block, an abnormal heartbeat, or a very slow heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart disorders. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

LOXICARD INJECTION should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is considered necessary by the physician. It is not recommended for use in neonates aged less than 1 month. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.
LOXICARD INJECTION should be used with caution with elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before receiving it.

Others

LOXICARD INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have low blood volume
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before receiving LOXICARD INJECTION, inform your physician if you:

Are feeling sick or tired for no reason
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have glaucoma
Have low potassium levels in the blood, causing muscle cramps and constipation
Recently had vomiting, diarrhea, or excessive blood loss
Are not drinking enough amount of water
Have too much acidity in the blood
Have any skin infection (with pus) in and around the areas where the medicine is planned to be administered
Have problems thinking or reasoning
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness or tenderness)
Have stroke
Have an imbalance in the constituents of the blood
Have a blood disorder

name: PRILOX Cream 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About PRILOX CREAM

PRILOX CREAM is a combination of Lignocaine and Prilocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anesthetic agents. It is used to cause temporary numbness (loss of pain sensation) of the normal intact skin and genital mucosal membranes when applied topically.

It is primarily used to abolish pain signals prior to surgical and diagnostic procedures on the skin and genital areas (such as during insertion of needles or catheters, during certain painful vaccinations (such as MMR, flu, hepatitis, DPT), during minor surgeries of genital areas (such as removal of foreskin around the penis) and during laser management or other cosmetic procedures involving the skin surface).

PRILOX CREAM can also be used to temporarily numb skin before injecting an anesthetic solution and can be used to abolish pain signals while removing dead and damaged skin/cells among patients with leg ulcers. It also provides relief from the symptoms of atopic dermatitis (red, itchy skin) in adults.

PRILOX CREAM is suitable for use both in adults and in children (including infants and newborns). It should be used only under careful medical supervision. It will be applied to you only by a doctor or nurse at skin surfaces where loss of sensation is required.

Before PRILOX CREAM is applied onto your skin, inform your doctor if you have any genetic disorders (like G6PD deficiency) or blood problems (such as methemoglobinemia). You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before this medicine is given to you as a precaution.

PRILOX CREAM is not suitable for use in patients with problems in ear drum. The most common side effects of using PRILOX CREAM are paleness, redness, swelling, mild burning sensation, itching or warmth at the managed area. Consult your doctor if it bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About LOX 2% INJECTION

LOX 2% INJECTION contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause numbness (loss of sensation) of body parts in the regions where it has been administered (local anesthesia). It is generally used prior to spinal anesthesia or before surgical procedures to cause a temporary loss of sensation. It also helps to control the heartbeat in patients with arrythmia (an irregular heartbeat).

LOX 2% INJECTION will be given to you only by a trained anaesthesiologist around the areas (such as hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, and spine) locally where loss of sensation (numbness) is required.

Before receiving LOX 2% INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any breathing disorders, blood problems, epilepsy, glaucoma, stroke, dehydration, low blood potassium levels, or muscle weakness.

LOX 2% INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving LOX 2% INJECTION are nausea, slow heart rate, dizziness, lower back pain, difficulty walking, and an inability to control urine or bowel movements. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Uses Of LOX 2% INJECTION
Causes numbness of body parts when used prior to spinal anesthesia or surgical procedures
To manage arrythmia (an irregular heartbeat)
mechanismOfAction:
How LOX 2% INJECTION Works

LOX 2% INJECTION is an anaesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness in body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that cause pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral parts of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, and pelvis) to the brain, which leads to a loss of sensation. It also normalizes heart rate by blocking the generation of abnormal electrical signals in the heart.
usageDetails:
How to use LOX 2% INJECTION

LOX 2% INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anaesthesiologist. Your doctor or anaesthesiologist will decide the correct dose and site of administration for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition, and the type of nerve block that is required to provide anesthesia or pain relief.

It can be administered locally to the region where loss of sensation (numbness) is required or can be administered in a vein, around the spinal cord, or a nerve to cause numbness during surgeries (caesarean section or other major surgeries) to stop pain sensation.

introduction:
Introduction About NEOROF 1% INJECTION

NEOROF 1% INJECTION contains Propofol which belongs to the group of medicines called General Anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. It can also be used to induce sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

NEOROF 1% INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously). It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 month or older). It is mostly used in combination with other local anaesthetics to achieve faster results.

Before receiving NEOROF 1% INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood cholesterol levels or dehydration as a precaution.

NEOROF 1% INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.

The most common side effects of receiving NEOROF 1% INJECTION are pain, swelling and redness at the site of injection, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, headache and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About PROPOVAN 1% INJECTION

PROPOVAN 1% INJECTION contains Propofol which belongs to the group of medicines called General Anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. It can also be used to induce sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

PROPOVAN 1% INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously). It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 month or older). It is mostly used in combination with other local anaesthetics to achieve faster results.

Before receiving PROPOVAN 1% INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood cholesterol levels or dehydration as a precaution.

PROPOVAN 1% INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.

The most common side effects of receiving PROPOVAN 1% INJECTION are pain, swelling and redness at the site of injection, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, headache and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: EL Ligno 2% Jelly 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About EL LIGNO 2% JELLY

EL LIGNO 2% JELLY contains Lignocaine which belongs to the group of medicines called Local Anesthetic agents. It causes numbness of body parts at sites where it has been applied. It is used for temporary relief of pain and discomfort associated with skin abrasions, sun burns, insect bites, sore nipples, hemorrhoids (piles), anal fissures, bed sores and shingles or cold sores (pain skin rash or blisters around the mouth due to viral infections).

It can also be used to relieve pain following circumcision in children (a surgery that removes the foreskin from human penis) and can be used to soothe itching around the rectum, anus (pruritus ani), or female genitalia (vulva).

It also relieves pain caused due to oral sores and can numb the mouth and throat prior to any dental procedures (such as scaling or denture fixing).

It acts as an anesthetic lubricant for catheterization, intubation and for other diagnostic procedures (such as proctoscopy, rectoscopy, cystoscopy, gastroscopy, bronchoscopy, esophagoscopy etc.)

If you are managed with EL LIGNO 2% JELLY in your oral cavity, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 60 minutes or until sensation comes back in your mouth. This is because you may experience trouble in swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period.

Before using EL LIGNO 2% JELLY inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any infections or injuries at the site of application as a precaution.

EL LIGNO 2% JELLY can be used in pregnant and breastfeeding women if considered necessary. It is generally safe and well tolerated without any major side effects. However, if you experience any skin rash or irritation in the application site or feel drowsy consult your doctor for advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How EL LIGNO 2% JELLY Works

EL LIGNO 2% JELLY is a local anesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness of body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that causes pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral part of the body (i.e., face, hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, genitals or where the medicine has been applied) to the brain which ultimately leads to loss of sensation.
usageDetails:
How to use EL LIGNO 2% JELLY

EL LIGNO 2% JELLY should be used under proper medical supervision. It is administered by the physician at the region where anesthesia is required. However, it can also be self-administered by the patients if instructed by the doctor.

Take a small quantity of EL LIGNO 2% JELLY and apply on the required areas. Avoid contact of EL LIGNO 2% JELLY with your eyes.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition and sites where numbness is required in the body.

Signs of methemoglobinemia (such as pale, grey, or bluish discoloration of the skin, headache, abnormal or irregular heartbeat, dizziness, and tiredness etc.)

Dizziness or drowsiness, confusion, shortness of breath, ringing in the ears, blurred vision, slow heartbeat, feeling faint, nervousness, unusual sweating, trembling or seizures
Signs of methemoglobinemia (such as pale, grey, or bluish discoloration of the skin, headache, abnormal or irregular heartbeat, dizziness, and tiredness etc.)

introduction:
Introduction About XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION

XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause numbness (loss of sensation) of body parts in the regions where it has been administered (local anesthesia). It is generally used prior to spinal anesthesia or before surgical procedures to cause a temporary loss of sensation. It also helps to control the heartbeat in patients with arrythmia (an irregular heartbeat).

XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION will be given to you only by a trained anaesthesiologist around the areas (such as hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, and spine) locally where loss of sensation (numbness) is required.

Before receiving XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any breathing disorders, blood problems, epilepsy, glaucoma, stroke, dehydration, low blood potassium levels, or muscle weakness.

XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION are nausea, slow heart rate, dizziness, lower back pain, difficulty walking, and an inability to control urine or bowel movements. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION Works

XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION is an anaesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness in body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that cause pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral parts of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, and pelvis) to the brain, which leads to a loss of sensation. It also normalizes heart rate by blocking the generation of abnormal electrical signals in the heart.

How to use XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION

XYLOCAINE 1% INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anaesthesiologist. Your doctor or anaesthesiologist will decide the correct dose and site of administration for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition, and the type of nerve block that is required to provide anesthesia or pain relief.

It can be administered locally to the region where loss of sensation (numbness) is required or can be administered in a vein, around the spinal cord, or a nerve to cause numbness during surgeries (caesarean section or other major surgeries) to stop pain sensation.

introduction:
Introduction About NEOROF 1% INJECTION

NEOROF 1% INJECTION contains Propofol which belongs to the group of medicines called General Anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. It can also be used to induce sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

NEOROF 1% INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously). It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 month or older). It is mostly used in combination with other local anaesthetics to achieve faster results.

Before receiving NEOROF 1% INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood cholesterol levels or dehydration as a precaution.

NEOROF 1% INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.

The most common side effects of receiving NEOROF 1% INJECTION are pain, swelling and redness at the site of injection, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, headache and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEOROF 1% INJECTION Works

NEOROF 1% INJECTION is a general anaesthetic agent. It produces loss of consciousness by potentiating the actions of certain brain chemicals (GABA) any by decreasing the flow of certain ions (chloride) across the nerve cells that is required to maintain alertness.

Your doctor/ anesthesiologist will decide the correct dose for you depending upon the age, body weight and disease condition.

name: SEVURA INHALER 250 ML
introduction:
Introduction About SEVURA INHALER 250 ML

SEVURA INHALER 250 ML contains Sevoflurane, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anesthetics. It is used to induce and maintain a deep, pain-free sleep (general anesthesia) in adults and children during an operation.

SEVURA INHALER 250 ML is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, QT prolongation, or torsade de pointes, which may also be associated with QT prolongation. Consult your doctor before using it.

SEVURA INHALER 250 ML should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease, respiratory depression (breathing difficulties), heart disease, low blood pressure or low blood volume or blood circulation problems, or coronary artery disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

If you are pregnant, trying to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. Consult your doctor before receiving SEVURA INHALER 250 ML, as the safety of this medicine in pregnancy and breastfeeding is not known.

The most common side effects of receiving SEVURA INHALER 250 ML are restlessness, slow heart rate, low blood pressure, coughing, nausea and vomiting, and delirium. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: To induce and maintain a deep, pain-free sleep (general anesthesia) in adults and children during an operation.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SEVURA INHALER 250 ML
To induce and maintain a deep, pain-free sleep (general anesthesia) in adults and children during an operation.
mechanismOfAction:
How SEVURA INHALER 250 ML Works

SEVURA INHALER 250 ML work by temporarily reducing the activity of the body’s central nervous system. This causes a complete loss of sensation in the body, including loss of consciousness, allowing surgery to be carried out without pain or distress.
usageDetails:
How to use SEVURA INHALER 250 ML

SEVURA INHALER 250 ML will be given to you by an anesthetist. Sevoflurane liquid is changed to gas in a vaporizer, and you will then breathe this in as a vapor. It may be used to put you to sleep before your operation, or if you are put to sleep with an injection, it may be used to maintain anesthesia during the operation. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the type of operation, etc.

Have Down syndrome

name: THEMICAINE 2% Injection 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause numbness (loss of sensation) of body parts in the regions where it has been administered (local anesthesia). It is generally used prior to spinal anesthesia or before surgical procedures to cause a temporary loss of sensation. It also helps to control the heartbeat in patients with arrythmia (an irregular heartbeat).

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION will be given to you only by a trained anaesthesiologist around the areas (such as hands, legs, abdomen, pelvis, and spine) locally where loss of sensation (numbness) is required.

Before receiving THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any breathing disorders, blood problems, epilepsy, glaucoma, stroke, dehydration, low blood potassium levels, or muscle weakness.

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if considered necessary by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION are nausea, slow heart rate, dizziness, lower back pain, difficulty walking, and an inability to control urine or bowel movements. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION Works

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION is an anaesthetic agent. It reduces pain sensation and causes numbness in body parts by blocking the flow of certain ions (sodium ions) through the nerves that cause pain sensation. As a result, it limits the transfer of pain signals from the peripheral parts of the body (i.e., the face, hands, legs, abdomen, and pelvis) to the brain, which leads to a loss of sensation. It also normalizes heart rate by blocking the generation of abnormal electrical signals in the heart.
usageDetails:
How to use THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anaesthesiologist. Your doctor or anaesthesiologist will decide the correct dose and site of administration for you depending upon your age, body weight, health condition, and the type of nerve block that is required to provide anesthesia or pain relief.

It can be administered locally to the region where loss of sensation (numbness) is required or can be administered in a vein, around the spinal cord, or a nerve to cause numbness during surgeries (caesarean section or other major surgeries) to stop pain sensation.

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION should be used for breastfeeding women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, inform your doctor before receiving THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION if you are breastfeeding.

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION may make you feel dizzy or drowsy for some time after administration. Therefore, do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your abilities are affected by THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION.
Avoid the consumption of alcohol before receiving THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION.
THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Inform your doctor before receiving THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION if you are allergic to lignocaine or to any other local anaesthetics (such as bupivacaine).
THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with breathing disorders (such as asthma or COPD). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart diseases (such as heart block, an abnormal heartbeat, or a very slow heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart disorders. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is considered necessary by the physician. It is not recommended for use in neonates aged less than 1 month. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.
THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION should be used with caution with elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before receiving it.

Others

THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have low blood volume
Have porphyria (an inherited blood disorder)

Before receiving THEMICAINE 2% INJECTION, inform your physician if you:

Are feeling sick or tired for no reason
Have epilepsy (fits)
Have glaucoma
Have low potassium levels in the blood, causing muscle cramps and constipation
Recently had vomiting, diarrhea, or excessive blood loss
Are not drinking enough amount of water
Have too much acidity in the blood
Have any skin infection (with pus) in and around the areas where the medicine is planned to be administered
Have problems thinking or reasoning
Have myasthenia gravis (severe muscle weakness or tenderness)
Have stroke
Have an imbalance in the constituents of the blood
Have a blood disorder

introduction:
Introduction About RAPIFOL 10MG INJECTION

RAPIFOL 10MG INJECTION contains Propofol which belongs to the group of medicines called General Anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. It can also be used to induce sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

RAPIFOL 10MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously). It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 month or older). It is mostly used in combination with other local anaesthetics to achieve faster results.

Before receiving RAPIFOL 10MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood cholesterol levels or dehydration as a precaution.

RAPIFOL 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.

The most common side effects of receiving RAPIFOL 10MG INJECTION are pain, swelling and redness at the site of injection, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, headache and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. name: Lignocad 2% Gel 30gm
introduction:
Introduction About LIGNOCAD 2% GEL

LIGNOCAD 2% GEL contains Lignocaine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Local anaesthetic agents. It causes numbness of body parts at sites where it has been applied. It is used for temporary relief of pain and discomfort associated with skin abrasions, sun burns, insect bites, sore nipples, haemorrhoids (piles), anal fissures, bed sores, shingles, or cold sores (painful skin rash or blisters around the mouth due to viral infections).

It can also be used to relieve pain following circumcision in children (a surgery that removes the foreskin from the human penis) and to soothe itching around the rectum, anus (pruritus ani), or female genitalia (vulva).

It also relieves pain caused by oral sores and can numb the mouth and throat prior to any dental procedures (such as scaling or denture fixing).

It acts as an anaesthetic lubricant for catheterization, intubation, and other diagnostic procedures (such as proctoscopy, rectoscopy, cystoscopy, gastroscopy, bronchoscopy, esophagoscopy, etc.).

If you are managed with LIGNOCAD 2% GEL in your oral cavity, avoid oral foods or chewing gums for at least 60 minutes or until sensation comes back in your mouth. This is because you may experience trouble swallowing or accidentally bite your tongue or cheek muscles during this period.

Before using LIGNOCAD 2% GEL, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any infections or injuries at the site of application as a precaution.

LIGNOCAD 2% GEL can be used for pregnant and breastfeeding women if considered necessary. It is generally safe and well tolerated without any major side effects. However, if you experience any skin rash or irritation on the application site or feel drowsy, consult your doctor for advice.
