name: MCT Rof 10mg Injection 20ml
introduction:
Introduction About MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION contains Propofol which belongs to the group of medicines called General Anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. It can also be used to induce sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously). It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 month or older). It is mostly used in combination with other local anaesthetics to achieve faster results.

Before receiving MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood cholesterol levels or dehydration as a precaution.

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.

The most common side effects of receiving MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION are pain, swelling and redness at the site of injection, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, headache and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION Works

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION is a general anaesthetic agent. It produces loss of consciousness by potentiating the actions of certain brain chemicals (GABA) any by decreasing the flow of certain ions (chloride) across the nerve cells that is required to maintain alertness.

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is considered necessary by the physician. It is not recommended for use in neonates aged less than 1 month. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before receiving it.

introduction:
Introduction About ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION

ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION contains Isoflurane which belongs to a group of medicines known as General Anaesthetics. ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is used for induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia during surgeries.

General Anaesthesia can be defined as a state of controlled unconsciousness. There is temporary reduction in activity of central nervous system in brain which in result causes complete loss of sensation in body and loss of consciousness, which is required during surgery.

ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is not recommended for use in patients with or family history of rapid rise in body temperature during anaesthesia (a condition known as malignant hyperthermia). ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in patients having liver, heart, kidney or lung problems, increased intracranial pressure, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or diabetes.

ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly necessary. ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it passes through the breast milk. ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in children so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. The most common side effects of using ISIFRANE 250 LIQUID FOR INHALATION are agitation, breath holding, chills or shivering, cough, change in mental abilities, spasm of vocal cords, nausea and vomiting. Consult your physician in case any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION

ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION contains Isoflurane which belongs to a group of medicines known as General Anaesthetics. ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is used for induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia during surgeries.

General Anaesthesia can be defined as a state of controlled unconsciousness. There is temporary reduction in activity of central nervous system in brain which in result causes complete loss of sensation in body and loss of consciousness, which is required during surgery.

ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is not recommended for use in patients with or family history of rapid rise in body temperature during anaesthesia (a condition known as malignant hyperthermia). ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in patients having liver, heart, kidney or lung problems, increased intracranial pressure, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or diabetes.

ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly necessary. ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it passes through the breast milk. ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in children so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. The most common side effects of using ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION are agitation, breath holding, chills or shivering, cough, change in mental abilities, spasm of vocal cords, nausea and vomiting. Consult your physician in case any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia during surgeries

Induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia during surgeries
mechanismOfAction:
How ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION Works

ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is a general anaesthetic that works by temporarily reducing the activity of the body’s central nervous system. This leads to complete loss of sensation in the body, including loss of consciousness and allowing surgery to be carried out without any pain or distress.

Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition and the type of operation you are having and when ISOTROY 100 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is to be given.

name: Troypofol Injection 20ml
introduction:
Introduction About TROYPOFOL INJECTION

TROYPOFOL INJECTION contains Propofol which belongs to the group of medicines called General Anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. It can also be used to induce sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

TROYPOFOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously). It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 month or older). It is mostly used in combination with other local anaesthetics to achieve faster results.

Before receiving TROYPOFOL INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood cholesterol levels or dehydration as a precaution.

TROYPOFOL INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.

The most common side effects of receiving TROYPOFOL INJECTION are pain, swelling and redness at the site of injection, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, headache and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Induces sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU)

Uses Of TROYPOFOL INJECTION
Used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness prior to surgical procedures
Induces sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
mechanismOfAction:
How TROYPOFOL INJECTION Works

TROYPOFOL INJECTION is a general anaesthetic agent. It produces loss of consciousness by potentiating the actions of certain brain chemicals (GABA) any by decreasing the flow of certain ions (chloride) across the nerve cells that is required to maintain alertness.

TROYPOFOL INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor/ anesthesiologist will decide the correct dose for you depending upon the age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until the effects of the medicine complete wears off
Avoid consumption of alcohol before receiving TROYPOFOL INJECTION.

TROYPOFOL INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Inform your doctor before receiving TROYPOFOL INJECTION, if you are allergic to Propofol.
TROYPOFOL INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with breathing disorders (such as asthma or COPD). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
TROYPOFOL INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart disorders. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

Before receiving TROYPOFOL INJECTION, inform your physician if you:

Ever had epilepsy (fits)
Have high blood cholesterol levels
Are dehydrated
Have mitochondrial diseases
Are generally unwell

Use in pediatrics:

TROYPOFOL INJECTION should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is considered necessary by the physician. It is not recommended for use in neonates aged less than 1 month. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.

Use in geriatrics:

TROYPOFOL INJECTION should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before receiving it.

introduction:
Introduction About SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION contains Sevoflurane, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anesthetics. It is used to induce and maintain a deep, pain-free sleep (general anesthesia) in adults and children during an operation.

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, QT prolongation, or torsade de pointes, which may also be associated with QT prolongation. Consult your doctor before using it.

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease, respiratory depression (breathing difficulties), heart disease, low blood pressure or low blood volume or blood circulation problems, or coronary artery disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

If you are pregnant, trying to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. Consult your doctor before receiving SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION, as the safety of this medicine in pregnancy and breastfeeding is not known.

The most common side effects of receiving SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION are restlessness, slow heart rate, low blood pressure, coughing, nausea and vomiting, and delirium. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: To induce and maintain a deep, pain-free sleep (general anesthesia) in adults and children during an operation.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION
To induce and maintain a deep, pain-free sleep (general anesthesia) in adults and children during an operation.
mechanismOfAction:
How SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION Works

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION work by temporarily reducing the activity of the body’s central nervous system. This causes a complete loss of sensation in the body, including loss of consciousness, allowing surgery to be carried out without pain or distress.
usageDetails:
How to use SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION will be given to you by an anesthetist. Sevoflurane liquid is changed to gas in a vaporizer, and you will then breathe this in as a vapor. It may be used to put you to sleep before your operation, or if you are put to sleep with an injection, it may be used to maintain anesthesia during the operation. Your doctor will decide the correct dose, duration, and frequency for you depending on the type of operation, etc.

AV blockade (a disorder of the electrical conduction of the heart)

If you are breast-feeding, consult your doctor before receiving SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION, as the safety of this medicine in breast-feeding is not known. Breast-feeding should be avoided for 48 hours after administration of SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION and breast milk discarded during that period.

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION may affect your ability to drive or use machines for some time after administration. Therefore, you should not drive or operate machinery until your doctor advises that you may do so.
Avoid alcohol consumption while taking SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION.

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is not recommended for use if you are allergic to sevoflurane, any other anesthetics, or any of the other ingredients.
SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION should be used with caution in patients with respiratory depression (breathing difficulties) or who have taken medicines that cause respiratory depression.

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is not recommended for use if you have ever had QT prolongation (prolongation of a specific time interval in an ECG) or torsade de pointes (a specific type of heart rhythm), which may also be associated with QT prolongation. It should be used with caution in patients with heart disease, low blood pressure or low blood volume, or who have blood circulation problems or coronary artery disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

Others

SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION is not recommended for use if:

You have been told previously that you should not receive general anesthesia
You or any member of your family has experienced a condition called malignant hyperthermia (a rapid rise in body temperature) during an operation with Sevoflurane or any other anesthetic
You are undergoing dental procedures outside a hospital or daycare unit
Are prone to or at risk of seizures (fits)
Have a mitochondrial disorder (Ex. Leigh’s syndrome)

Before receiving SEVFURANE 50 LIQUID FOR INHALATION, inform your doctor if you:

Have brain problems
Have severe headaches
Have nausea and vomiting
Have received Sevoflurane or any other anesthetics within the last three months
Are at risk of increased intracranial pressure (rise in pressure inside the skull), such as from a head injury or brain tumour
Are undergoing an obstetrical operation
Have seizures or seizure disorders (fits)
Have Pompe’s disease (a metabolic disorder)
Have a severe muscle disorder such as Duchenne muscular dystrophy, myasthenia gravis
Have Down syndrome

introduction:
Introduction About MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION contains Propofol which belongs to the group of medicines called General Anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. It can also be used to induce sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously). It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 month or older). It is mostly used in combination with other local anaesthetics to achieve faster results.

Before receiving MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood cholesterol levels or dehydration as a precaution.

MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.

The most common side effects of receiving MCT ROF 10MG INJECTION are pain, swelling and redness at the site of injection, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, headache and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: Sosrane Liquid 250ml
introduction:
Introduction About SOSRANE LIQUID

SOSRANE LIQUID contains Isoflurane which belongs to a group of medicines known as General Anaesthetics. SOSRANE LIQUID is used for induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia during surgeries.

General Anaesthesia can be defined as a state of controlled unconsciousness. There is temporary reduction in activity of central nervous system in brain which in result causes complete loss of sensation in body and loss of consciousness, which is required during surgery.

SOSRANE LIQUID is not recommended for use in patients with or family history of rapid rise in body temperature during anaesthesia (a condition known as malignant hyperthermia). SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in patients having liver, heart, kidney or lung problems, increased intracranial pressure, myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness) or diabetes.

SOSRANE LIQUID is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly necessary. SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it passes through the breast milk. SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in children so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. The most common side effects of using SOSRANE LIQUID are agitation, breath holding, chills or shivering, cough, change in mental abilities, spasm of vocal cords, nausea and vomiting. Consult your physician in case any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia during surgeries
usesDetails:
Uses Of SOSRANE LIQUID
Induction and maintenance of general anaesthesia during surgeries
mechanismOfAction:
How SOSRANE LIQUID Works

SOSRANE LIQUID is a general anaesthetic that works by temporarily reducing the activity of the body’s central nervous system. This leads to complete loss of sensation in the body, including loss of consciousness and allowing surgery to be carried out without any pain or distress.
usageDetails:
How to use SOSRANE LIQUID

SOSRANE LIQUID is administered by your doctor through a vaporizer. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition and the type of operation you are having and when SOSRANE LIQUID is to be given.
sideEffects: High blood pressure causing headache, altered vision, nausea, vomiting
Low blood pressure (light-headedness, especially when getting up from a lying or sitting position)
Allergic reaction like skin rash or swelling of the face
Malignant hyperthermia (high fever, muscle rigidity, tachycardia, tachypnoea, cyanosis, arrhythmias, unstable blood pressure)
Increase in blood potassium levels (abnormality of heart rhythm in children during the postoperative period)
Increased heart rate and irregular heartbeats
Increase in white blood cells, blood glucose, blood levels of certain enzymes and other blood cells
Agitation, delirium, mood problems, mental impairment, fits
Liver disease (yellowing of the skin and white of the eyes, abdominal pain)
Excessive blood loss after surgeries involving the womb
Small changes in moods (symptoms may persist up to 6 days after administration)
Increase in blood fluoride levels (due to your body breaking down isoflurane) with carbon monoxide levels

If you or your child suffer from any of the following side effects after an operation, tell your doctor or anaesthetist immediately:

Feel shivery, nausea, vomiting
Allergic reaction like skin rash or swelling of the face
Malignant hyperthermia (high fever, muscle rigidity, tachycardia, tachypnoea, cyanosis, arrhythmias, unstable blood pressure)
Fall in blood pressure

Difficulty breathing (bronchospasm)
Increased heart rate and irregular heartbeats
Increase in white blood cells, blood glucose, blood levels of certain enzymes and other blood cells

Liver disease (yellowing of the skin and white of the eyes, abdominal pain)
Excessive blood loss after surgeries involving the womb

Increase in blood fluoride levels (due to your body breaking down isoflurane) with carbon monoxide levels

warnings.details: SOSRANE LIQUID is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless it is clearly necessary. Consult your doctor for advice.
SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known whether it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor for advice.
SOSRANE LIQUID affects your mental alertness for 2-4 days. Do not drive or operate machines after administration of SOSRANE LIQUID.
SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor for advice.

SOSRANE LIQUID is not recommended for use in patients with a history of hepatitis due to a halogenated inhalational anaesthetic or a history of unexplained moderate to severe hepatic dysfunction (Ex. jaundice associated with fever and/or eosinophilia) after anaesthesia with SOSRANE LIQUID or other halogenated inhalational anaesthetics. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not use SOSRANE LIQUID if you are allergic to isoflurane, other halogenated agents or any of the other ingredients of medicine.

SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in patients having respiratory problems such as bronchoconstriction (tightening of air sacs in lungs causing coughing, wheezing, shortness of breath). Consult your doctor for advice.

SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in patients suffering from heart problems such as coronary heart disease, arrythmias (irregular heartbeat), QT prolongation, Torsade’s De pointes (a specific type of raised heart rate), low blood pressure or low blood volume. Consult your doctor for advice.

Others

SOSRANE LIQUID is not recommended for use if you:

Or anyone in your family, are susceptible to rapid rise in body temperature during anaesthesia (a condition known as malignant hyperthermia)
Are contraindicated to general anaesthesia

Before receiving SOSRANE LIQUID inform your doctor if you have:

Mitochondrial disease
Increased intracranial pressure (increase in pressure in brain)
Duchenne muscular dystrophy (inherited muscular weakness)
Myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
A disease or illness which is not related to condition for which you are undergoing surgery (Ex. severe headache, nausea, vomiting, neuromuscular disease)
Cancer
Diabetes
Weakness
Previously been given an inhaled anaesthetic, especially in the last 3 months
Reacted badly after previous administration of SOSRANE LIQUID or other similar anaesthetics (Ex. development of jaundice, fever, liver or blood problems)

Use in Paediatrics:

SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in children as it may cause increase in saliva flow and respiratory secretions and cause laryngospasm (spasm of vocal cord). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

SOSRANE LIQUID should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years of age as it may require dose adjustments. Consult your doctor for advice.

name: Xamdex Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About XAMDEX INJECTION

XAMDEX INJECTION contains Dexmedetomidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Sedatives. It is used in adults to provide sedation (a state of calm, drowsiness or sleep) in hospital intensive care settings. It is also used to provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures.

XAMDEX INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders, a history of stroke or other serious conditions affecting the blood supply to the brain. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

XAMDEX INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney or liver problems, abnormally slow heart rate, low blood pressure or chronic hypertension, low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding), diabetes mellitus, neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke). Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

XAMDEX INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy and breastfeeding unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

XAMDEX INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects of receiving XAMDEX INJECTION are slow heart rate, low or high blood pressure, change in breathing pattern. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms get worse.
uses: To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
usesDetails:

To provide sedation for adult patients in hospital intensive care settings
To provide conscious sedation during different diagnostic or surgical procedures
mechanismOfAction:
How XAMDEX INJECTION Works

XAMDEX INJECTION works by binding to certain receptors in the brain called alpha-2 adrenoceptors and manages the release of norepinephrine (a chemical called neurotransmitter). Thus providing pain relief during procedures.
usageDetails:
How to use XAMDEX INJECTION

XAMDEX INJECTION is administered to you by a doctor or nurse prior to and/or during diagnostic or surgical procedures requiring sedation (procedural/conscious sedation). It is diluted and it is given to you as an infusion (drip) into your veins.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight, general condition of health, the level of sedation needed and how you respond to the medicine.
sideEffects: Change in breathing pattern or shortness of breath
Hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not present)

Low or high blood pressure
Change in breathing pattern or shortness of breath
Chest pain or heart attack

Restlessness
High temperature
Uncommon

Swelling of the stomach

warnings.details: XAMDEX INJECTION should not be used during pregnancy unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX INJECTION.
XAMDEX INJECTION should not be used in breast feeding women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX INJECTION.

XAMDEX INJECTION has major impact on the ability to drive and use machines. After you have been given this medicine, you must not drive, operate machinery or work in dangerous situations until the effects are completely gone. Ask your doctor when you can start doing these activities again and when you can go back to this kind of work.
Talk to your doctor about the use of alcohol after sedation/wake-up.
XAMDEX INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe kidney problems. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX INJECTION.
XAMDEX INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from severe liver problems. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX INJECTION.
Do not receive this medicine if you are allergic to dexmedetomidine or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

XAMDEX INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart rhythm disorders (heart block grade 2 or 3), very low blood pressure which does not respond to> management. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

Others

XAMDEX INJECTION is not recommended for you, if you have:

Recently had a stroke or other serious condition affecting blood supply to the brain

Before receiving XAMDEX INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Low blood volume (Ex. after bleeding)
Neurological disorder (Ex. head or spinal cord injury or stroke)
Ever developed a serious fever after taking some medicines called anaesthetics
Diabetes mellitus

Use in pediatrics:

The safety and efficacy of XAMDEX INJECTION in pediatric patients have not been established for procedural or ICU sedation. Consult your doctor before receiving XAMDEX INJECTION.

Use in geriatrics:

XAMDEX INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients aged above 65 years due to increased risk of low heart rate and low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving this medicine.

name: Troypofol Mct 10mg Injection 20ml
introduction:
Introduction About TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION

TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION contains Propofol which belongs to the group of medicines called General Anaesthetic agents. It is used to cause partial or complete loss of consciousness in patients so that surgical procedures can be performed. Unconsciousness caused by propofol is completely reversed once the effect of the medicine wears off. It can also be used to induce sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU).

TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or by a trained anesthesiologist into the vein (intravenously). It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged 1 month or older). It is mostly used in combination with other local anaesthetics to achieve faster results.

Before receiving TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have fits, high blood cholesterol levels or dehydration as a precaution.

TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.

The most common side effects of receiving TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION are pain, swelling and redness at the site of injection, low blood pressure, slow heartbeat, nausea, vomiting, headache and flushing. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Induces sleep in patients receiving artificial respiration in an Intensive Care Unit (ICU)

How TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION Works

TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION is a general anaesthetic agent. It produces loss of consciousness by potentiating the actions of certain brain chemicals (GABA) any by decreasing the flow of certain ions (chloride) across the nerve cells that is required to maintain alertness.

Your doctor/ anesthesiologist will decide the correct dose for you depending upon the age, body weight and disease condition.

Breastfeeding should be stopped for 24 hours or until the effect of the medicine completely wears off, as this medicine may pass to the nursing infant through the breast milk.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines until the effects of the medicine complete wears off
Avoid consumption of alcohol before receiving TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION.
TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
Inform your doctor before receiving TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION, if you are allergic to Propofol.
TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with breathing disorders (such as asthma or COPD). Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.
TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with heart disorders. Therefore, consult your doctor before receiving it.

Others

Before receiving TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION, inform your physician if you:

Ever had epilepsy (fits)
Have high blood cholesterol levels
Are dehydrated
Have mitochondrial diseases
Are generally unwell

Use in pediatrics:

TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION should be used in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) only if it is considered necessary by the physician. It is not recommended for use in neonates aged less than 1 month. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.

Use in geriatrics:

TROYPOFOL MCT 10MG INJECTION should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before receiving it.
